description: Rust source inclusion mechanisms the derivation of a crate's source set must follow or refuse. Resolved cases list the exact files a compilation of the crate (all targets, cfg(test) included) reads and must equal the derivation and cover what rustc --emit=dep-info reads; refused cases name the reason, and `outside` lists the files rustc reads outside the package directory, which a key derived from the directory alone would miss. rustc is the independent oracle of every row.

cases.name: path-mount-outside-the-package-directory
cases.mechanism: path attribute on a mod

files.owner/🦀️.rs:
#[path="✂️span/🦀️.rs"] pub mod span;
#[path = "🩹️patch/🦀️.rs"] pub mod patch;
